source_context: docs/training-policy.md: sustained interruption requires reassessment and an approved re-entry variant
provenance.limitations: This policy classifies evidence and readiness only. It contains no detraining formula, workload reduction, or return-to-running prescription.

states.currently_training: An explicit current-capacity confirmation permits supplied capacity facts to be evaluated by an authored preparation policy.
states.returning_after_break: Historical evidence is retained, but requires an authored return-to-running pathway before it can seed a workload.
states.first_time_runner: Requires an authored foundation-building pathway before a half-marathon workload can be proposed.
states.insufficient_current_evidence: The runner must add or confirm current context; missing evidence is not interpreted as zero.
states.health_review_required: Health or injury-related information blocks generation and follows the existing review pathway.

rules.historical_records: Preserve historical running records and their original dates.
rules.current_baseline: Use historical workload values as a current workload baseline only after explicit current-capacity confirmation and currently_training status.
rules.returning: Do not infer a workload or reduction from time away. Return policy_gap:return_to_running_pathway_not_authored until an exact reviewed pathway exists.
rules.first_time: Do not infer a foundation prescription. Return policy_gap:foundation_building_pathway_not_authored until an exact reviewed pathway exists.
rules.health: Reported health concern, health-related interruption, or illness_or_injury return reason returns health_review_required.

review_requirements: Qualified coach review of re-entry criteria and any future numerical re-entry workload rules.
Separate clinical/safety wording review for illness and injury escalation.
validation_cases: currently training with confirmed current capacity
